payload.title: Finish README reorder: fundamentals before scaling; deep walkthrough after How It Works
payload.body: PR #126 reordered the top of the README (Highlights -> Installation -> format teaser) but left the mid-document order as-is (defensible but improvable). Two remaining order smells: (1) the 70-line 'Worked example: first 10 minutes' deep walkthrough sits before 'Why TASKS.md?' and 'How It Works' — move it AFTER 'How It Works' so the conceptual frame precedes the hands-on dive; (2) 'Writing Good Tasks' + 'The Format' (fundamentals) come after 'Backends' + 'Workspaces' (scaling/advanced) — consider moving the fundamentals up, or Workspaces down. Deferred from #126 to avoid risky large-block moves in the same PR as the install-gap fix. Files: README.md. Low risk, low urgency — the top (above-the-fold) order is already best-practice.
